rationale: The candidate is visually coherent as a single object in each view, but the dominant read is an arbitrary stepped pyramid rather than a compact neighborhood living mass. The section is over-terraced and reads more like a stacked object than a building with active ground threshold, while the void/courtyard logic is too weak to register as public space. The blue access edge is not convincingly answered by a legible court, undercut, or entry seam, so the ground relationship remains sealed or semantically opposite to the verified frontage. Across views, the form is not collapsing into a physical collision, but the silhouette and hierarchy are inconsistent with the program brief: it lacks a calm, capacity-aware street building character and instead borrows tower-like stepped language from the references. It therefore fails program_fit_hard_pass.
